people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The children of Israel grieved for Benjamin their brother, and said, “There is one tribe cut off from Israel today.
translations.bsb: And the Israelites grieved for their brothers, the Benjamites, and said, “Today a tribe is cut off from Israel.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel repented them for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.
translations.asv: And the children of Israel repented them for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.
